system.description: The spell summons a violent storm around the enchanter. It sweeps up debris and creatures weighing less than 50 kg within a 20-meter radius. Creatures must make a Strength-modified Situation roll to resist being hurled away. Those blown into obstacles suffer falling damage; those who remain inside must test again to move through the storm and suffer penalties to their actions.
